title: September Exit Payroll Reconciliation
intended_scope: Calculate determinable September gross payroll input under assumed written company policy. Statutory benefits and deductions out of scope.

A.title: Payroll policy, clause 4
A.text: Base monthly salary AED 18,000; mid-month termination uses calendar days worked divided by 30 for September. Only approved allowances are paid.

B.title: Signed contract
B.text: Employee P-104 final day 20 September; monthly base AED 18,000; transport allowance AED 1,500 if approved in allowance register.

C.title: Payroll change log
C.text: Draft P-104 September payroll: base AED 18,000 and transport AED 1,500. Batch not approved.

D.title: HR exit approval
D.text: Manager confirms final employment day 20 September; ticket P-104 records exit in HRIS.

E.title: Allowance approval register
E.text: P-104 transport allowance pending; no approver or approval timestamp.
